data.title: Ocean House
data.about:
Ocean House provides luxury 2 to 4-bedroom apartments and 5 to 6-bedroom penthouses surrounded by palm trees, lush flora and a magnificent view of the ocean’s glimmering water.

Dive into luxury with these modern contemporary homes that evoke feelings of unparalleled calmness with its serene views
